name: File Manage (copy/move/mkdir)
purpose: Deterministic last-mile file placement: copy or move an existing file to a destination (a folder or a file path), or make a folder. Smart path resolution understands known folders (desktop/downloads/documents/pictures/music/videos/home/temp), ~, and %ENV% vars, so 'put it on my desktop' works by default; an existing destination is not overwritten unless overwrite is set.

inputs.name: source
inputs.description: copy/move: the existing file's path (absolute, ~, %ENV%, known-folder, or relative). Take it from the previous step's produced-file path.

inputs.name: dest
inputs.description: copy/move: the destination. A folder (known-folder like 'desktop', an existing dir, a trailing-slash path, or an extension-less path) keeps the source's filename; a full file path renames it.

inputs.name: path
inputs.description: mkdir: the folder to create (parents are created).

inputs.name: overwrite
inputs.description: copy/move: replace an existing destination file (else already_exists).

inputs.name: create_dirs
inputs.description: copy/move: create missing destination parent directories.

outputs.description: copy/move: {op, source, dest (final absolute path), dest_folder, filename, dest_was_dir, overwrote, bytes, sha256, source_still_exists}. mkdir: {op, path, created, existed}.
